answer: Proof-of-burn mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to destroy native tokens in an unspendable vault to mint an identity. Instead of fanning an ember of capital into swarms of cheap clones, an attacker incurs the verifiable, permanent destruction of liquid wealth per node. This creates an onyx barrier against automated registration. A key limitation is that wealthy adversaries can still buy influence, while unrecoverable burn costs exclude underfunded agents.
